title.en-US: Not One of the Three Major Ball Sports

prompt.zh-CN: 以下哪项不属于通常所说的世界三大球？
prompt.en-US: Which of the following is not one of the so-called three major ball sports?

reveal.zh-CN: 答案是乒乓球。三大球通常指足球、篮球和排球。
reveal.en-US: The answer is table tennis. The three major ball sports usually refer to soccer, basketball, and volleyball.

prompt.zh-CN: 橄榄球通常被认为起源于哪个国家？
prompt.en-US: Rugby football is usually considered to have originated in which country?

reveal.zh-CN: 答案是英国。橄榄球名称来自英格兰的拉格比学校传统。
reveal.en-US: The answer is England or the United Kingdom. Rugby football takes its name from the Rugby School tradition in England.
